nodes.speaker: Guard
nodes.text: I heard the Sage opened that old door. Whatever is down there, give it hell. I will keep watch up here.

nodes.speaker: Guard
nodes.text: Back again? The Sage sent word you would be coming. Go on through -- but I will tell you, something felt wrong down there even after the rats were cleared. A cold draft from somewhere deep.

actions.value: The Guard lets you pass into the cellar.

nodes.speaker: Guard
nodes.text: The Sage looks much happier now. Well done.

nodes.speaker: Guard
nodes.text: The Sage sent you? Good luck in there. Watch out for the rats -- they bite.

nodes.speaker: Guard
nodes.text: The cellar is off-limits. Too dangerous. Talk to the Sage if you have business here.
